metadata.title: Google taps Blue Origin's New Glenn for first heavy-lift launch of space-based AI project

content.text:
Google has chosen Blue Origin to carry out the first heavy-lift launch for Project Suncatcher, its long-term effort to build AI computing infrastructure in orbit and power it with solar energy, the company said Wednesday.
